{
  "center": {
    "title": "Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)",
    "gist": "A parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique that freezes base weights and trains low-rank decomposition matrices without inference latency.",
    "anchors": [
      "sec:1",
      "fig:1",
      "sec:4"
    ]
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "key": "intrinsic-rank",
      "title": "Intrinsic Rank Hypothesis",
      "gist": "Model parameter updates during downstream task adaptation lie within a low-dimensional subspace despite large nominal dimensions.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:3",
        "para:4.1:1",
        "para:7.2:2"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "low-rank-decomposition",
      "title": "Low-Rank Matrix Decomposition",
      "gist": "The weight update matrix is factorized into a product of two lower-rank matrices B and A.",
      "anchors": [
        "fig:1",
        "para:4.1:1",
        "eq:3"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "frozen-pretrained-weights",
      "title": "Frozen Pre-Trained Weights",
      "gist": "Original model parameters remain unchanged and receive no gradient updates during fine-tuning.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:3",
        "para:4.1:1",
        "para:4.2:2"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "asymmetric-initialization",
      "title": "Asymmetric Initialization",
      "gist": "Matrix A is initialized with Gaussian noise and B with zeros so the initial weight update is zero.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:4.1:2"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "scaling-factor",
      "title": "Scaling Factor Alpha",
      "gist": "Low-rank updates are scaled by alpha divided by rank, keeping hyperparameter tuning stable across different ranks.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:4.1:2"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "weight-merging",
      "title": "Weight Merging at Inference",
      "gist": "Multiplying and folding adapter matrices directly into base model weights avoids runtime inference latency.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:4",
        "para:4.1:4"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "attention-adaptation",
      "title": "Attention Weight Adaptation",
      "gist": "Restricting adapter injection to query and value projection matrices balances parameter thrift with high downstream task quality.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:4.2:1",
        "para:7.1:1",
        "tab:5"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "optimizer-memory-reduction",
      "title": "Optimizer Memory Reduction",
      "gist": "Omitting optimizer state tracking and gradients for frozen weights drastically lowers GPU memory consumption during training.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:4",
        "para:4.2:2"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "task-switching-efficiency",
      "title": "Efficient Task Switching",
      "gist": "Swapping small task-specific adapter weights while keeping the primary model resident in memory enables low-overhead multi-tenant serving.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:4",
        "para:4.2:2"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "full-fine-tuning",
      "title": "Full Fine-Tuning",
      "gist": "Updating all parameters across tasks incurs unsustainable GPU memory, computation, and checkpoint storage overheads for massive models.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:1",
        "para:2:3",
        "eq:1"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "adapter-latency",
      "title": "Adapter Inference Latency",
      "gist": "Sequential bottleneck adapter layers introduce computational delays during inference on parallel hardware, especially under small batch sizes.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:2",
        "para:3.adapter-layers-introduce-inference-laten:1",
        "tab:1",
        "fig:5"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "prefix-tuning",
      "title": "Prefix Tuning",
      "gist": "Continuous prompt optimization prepends trainable virtual token embeddings, which limits available context window and complicates optimization.",
      "anchors": [
        "para:1:2",
        "para:3.directly-optimizing-the-prompt-is-hard:1",
        "sec:5.1"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "subspace-similarity",
      "title": "Subspace Similarity Analysis",
      "gist": "Normalized Grassmann projection metric shows that low-rank adaptation updates align across different ranks and random seeds.",
      "anchors": [
        "sec:7.2",
        "eq:4",
        "sec:G"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    },
    {
      "key": "feature-amplification",
      "title": "Feature Amplification",
      "gist": "Low-rank updates strongly amplify task-relevant directional features already present but muted in the pre-trained model weights.",
      "anchors": [
        "sec:7.3",
        "tab:7",
        "sec:H.4"
      ],
      "is_first_principle": false    }
  ],
